Purpose: Controlled runtime comparison requested in reviewer Round 4; no automatic manuscript update
Opponents: unchanged frozen main-comparison implementations; not CDP variants
TimingStart: Immediately before initial sampling (CSASS); immediately before Solve including initial sampling (opponents)
TimingStop: After constrained SPEA2 selection of up to N true-evaluated points and feasible nondominated extraction
OutputSetRule: Full true evaluation history -> constrained SPEA2 up to N -> feasible nondominated subset
DiagnosticIGD: Frozen reference PF requested at 10000 points, raw objective units; computed outside runtime
DiagnosticHV: PF-only ideal/nadir normalization, common reference (1.1,1.1); computed outside runtime
Statistics: All 30 scheduled runtimes; sample standard deviation; final means only for 30/30 complete groups; no success-based filtering
FailurePolicy: Stop, preserve all records; no automatic retry or replacement seed
ResumePolicy: Same host, CPU, MATLAB, BLAS/LAPACK, power plan, thread count, locked package; committed records skipped after SHA256 validation
OrderPolicy: Four algorithms rotated by seed/problem; all 30 included including first-call overhead
Note: This is a new controlled runtime dataset. Diagnostic IGD/HV do not silently replace the main benchmark or ablation datasets.
